entities.summary: Mehak Gul is a Pakistani chess player. She earned the FIDE title of Woman Candidate Master (WCM) at the 42nd Chess Olympiad. She is the youngest Pakistani to achieve this title She also holds the world record for arranging a chessboard in forty five seconds.
